findings.title: publish_audit release gate can never return NO-GO for a P0
findings.recommendation: Share one gate function; add a P0 test asserting NO-GO; regenerate affected archived focused runs.

findings.title: emit accepts findings with no evidence or citation requirement
findings.recommendation: Require a non-empty evidence list (or an explicit Unknown marker) in emit for P0/P1 at minimum.

findings.title: Lab API has no rate limiting or request-body error signalling
findings.recommendation: Return 400 on invalid JSON and add a simple concurrency/rate guard.

findings.title: Required checks and PR/review rules do not match the documented gates
findings.recommendation: Add the pack CI contexts to the ruleset required checks and a pull_request rule with >=1 review.

findings.title: Required check 'Lab preflight / lab' is unobtainable for fork PRs
findings.recommendation: Make the required context a fork-safe pack check and run the lab check only on same-repo PRs/dispatch.

findings.title: Broken secret ignores + argv lab token + root lab API compose into an escalation path
findings.recommendation: Fix the ignore patterns, keep the token out of argv, bind to the overlay only, and run the API as an unprivileged user with a per-job allowlist.

findings.title: Required lab-preflight check cannot pass on fork pull requests
findings.recommendation: Skip the lab job (with a neutral/annotation) on `github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork`, or split the required check from the lab-dependent one.

findings.title: CI does not run shellcheck/actionlint on the pack's own shell/yaml despite shipping the scanners
findings.recommendation: Add a pack CI job that runs shellcheck on tools/**/*.sh and actionlint on .github/workflows/*.yml.

findings.title: [PORT] 2 tracked shell script(s) without the exec bit
README is stale: run count and tool/doc inventories omit current files
findings.recommendation: Regenerate the layout/counts (or generate the table) as part of the changelog checklist.

findings.title: Full-domain runs omit the master runner's required companion artifacts
findings.recommendation: Have aggregate render each companion (even as an explicit N/A stub) or add them to the run schema and `check_run.sh`.

findings.title: publish_audit relabels any run as a focused security/supply-chain/CI pass
findings.recommendation: Derive profile/prompts/report name from the run's `audit_manifest.json` mode instead of hardcoding the focused set.

findings.title: Release gate ignores coverage and completeness
findings.recommendation: Fail or downgrade the gate when any selected domain has not emitted, and record coverage in the gate basis.

findings.title: Registers are generated from report tables, so ID drift is possible across reruns
findings.recommendation: Write findings.json and the registers from the same in-memory list, and use findings.json as the source of truth.

findings.title: .gitignore is corrupted with intra-word spaces and an invalid inline comment
findings.recommendation: Restore the intended patterns and add a `git check-ignore` assertion to CI.

findings.title: Lab IAC has no drift detection or locked toolchain
findings.recommendation: Commit the lock file and add a scheduled read-only plan/check job against the lab.

findings.title: Run-freshness signal is documentation-only (no scheduled check or alert)
findings.recommendation: Add a scheduled job that runs the freshness check and alerts (reuse the lab ntfy workflow pattern).

findings.title: Full-domain runs generate no release notes or changelog draft
findings.recommendation: Have aggregate emit both drafts and make the pack changelog entry part of the completion checklist.

findings.title: Infrastructure toolchain is pinned only to lower bounds
findings.recommendation: Commit `.terraform.lock.hcl` and pin Ansible collections to exact versions committed alongside requirements.

findings.title: Workflows interpolate SSH secrets directly into run scripts
findings.recommendation: Pass the secret via `env:` (e.g. `SSH_KEY: ${{ secrets... }}`) and reference `"$SSH_KEY"` in the script.

findings.title: Lab API /sync ignores the supplied token when the workspace already exists
findings.recommendation: Apply the same `-c http.extraheader=...` (or `GIT_CONFIG_*`) to the fetch, and fail when the requested ref does not resolve.

findings.title: WireGuard/lab secret ignore patterns in .gitignore are corrupted
findings.recommendation: Restore the intended patterns ('*.swp', 'lab-audit-*.conf', '*.wgkey', 'deterministic-out/') and add a CI check that `git check-ignore` matches a sample secret file.

findings.title: The publish release-gate logic is untested and never returns NO-GO
findings.recommendation: Make publish_audit reuse the shared gate function and add a P0 test asserting NO-GO.

findings.title: No consolidated access-control matrix artifact is produced
findings.recommendation: Generate access_control_matrix.md from the ruleset/CODEOWNERS/workflow permissions during aggregate.

findings.title: run --agent-cmd executes a shell template with unvalidated substitutions
findings.recommendation: Pass arguments as an argv list instead of a formatted shell string.

findings.title: Lab API contract is documented in prose only (no schema)
findings.recommendation: Add a small JSON schema or shared constants module used by both server and client.

findings.title: Lab job API server and lab-vpn scripts have no automated test in CI
findings.recommendation: Add a unit test around Handler dispatch with a temp ROOT, or a lab smoke test in the preflight.

findings.title: Ruleset bypass actors permanently include the repository role and a deploy key
findings.recommendation: Scope bypass to the digest deploy key only, and record owner-authorized exceptions.

findings.title: [DEP] trivy not installed (dependency vuln scan skipped)
PR #49 (full-domain driver) has no CHANGELOG entry
findings.recommendation: Add the full-domain driver entry and a version note.

findings.title: No backup/restore drill plan artifact or tested lab restore
findings.recommendation: Add the drill plan (git-as-source-of-truth + lab rebuild) and an annual restore test.

findings.title: Roadmap robustness items 1-6 remain open
findings.recommendation: Close items 1-3 (deterministic LF digest, run schema, idempotent publish) first.

findings.title: Executive summary lists covered domains but not uncovered/N-A domains
findings.recommendation: Add a coverage line (emitted/NA/pending) to the summary.

findings.title: Two tracked shell scripts lack the executable bit
findings.recommendation: `git update-index --chmod=+x` both files and add a hygiene check.

findings.title: Example inventory is the only committed inventory
findings.recommendation: Document the variable source (env/secret) and validate the example against the Terraform outputs.

findings.title: Inventory tool does not model this pack's own artifact families
findings.recommendation: Add prompts/lenses/runs sections to `repo_inventory.py` output.

findings.title: No incident tabletop scenarios artifact
findings.recommendation: Author scenarios (leaked token, bad digest, runner down) with expected detections/actions.

findings.title: Lab API emits request lines only; no health/metrics for job durations or failures
findings.recommendation: Log auth/job results with duration and expose counters.

findings.title: Full-domain driver runs the orchestrator as a flat parallel domain
findings.recommendation: Either implement wave ordering/verification gates in `full_domain.py` or document explicitly that 00 is advisory when the driver is used.

findings.title: Full-domain passes are token-heavy with no inventory/deterministic caching
findings.recommendation: Cache per-repo inventory/deterministic output and feed it into the domain subagents.

findings.title: Lab job API is a single point of failure for lab-dependent work
findings.recommendation: Document a local MODE=local fallback per audit, or add a second runner/queue.

findings.title: No SBOM/provenance artifact or release manifest is published for the pack itself
findings.recommendation: Emit a CycloneDX SBOM and a signed release manifest per tagged pack release.

findings.title: gitleaks allowlist can mask real 40-hex OSQUERY keys and a token-shaped string
findings.recommendation: Scope allowlists to the exact file/line of the archived evidence rather than a global regex/literal.

findings.title: Lab API token passed via process argv and server bound to all interfaces as root
findings.recommendation: Pass credentials through the environment or a temporary askpass, bind to the overlay interface, and run as a dedicated non-root user.

findings.title: run_toolchain writes CSV to a fixed shared temp path
findings.recommendation: Use tempfile.mkdtemp()/NamedTemporaryFile for the CSV.

findings.title: The documented exec-bit invariant is not tested
findings.recommendation: Add a lint/test check over `git ls-files -s '*.sh'`.

findings.title: The end-to-end pass remains ~8 manual phases
findings.recommendation: Implement the documented `tools/post_audit.py run` orchestrator.
